nodes.label: Signal Re-analysis Job Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Allows admins to bulk-delete existing signals for a time window/company/type and re-run LLM analysis on their source documents, tracked via a polled background job with localStorage persistence so progress survives page reloads.

nodes.label: Crawl + Post-Processing Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Background thread pool crawls active sources concurrently, then analyses new/pending documents, generates a crawl briefing, and optionally runs post-processing: competitor summaries, intelligence briefing curation, and ExternalCompanyView synthesis for own-company signals.

nodes.label: Exponential Decay Weighting for Benchmarks
nodes.rationale: Uses per-period half-life lambda values (30d/90d/180d) to weight assessment age exponentially, so recency-focused periods emphasise recent signals while the 180d 'All' view stays near-flat/historical.

nodes.label: Movement Score Formula
nodes.rationale: Deterministic weighted formula: Score = (Relevanz×35) + (Confidence×20) + (Evidence×6) + Visibility-Bonus (low=0, medium=8, high=15), minus 10 for thought-leadership signals. Bands: 0-29 weak, 30-59 relevant, 60-79 strong, 80-100 market_shaping. Designed so deterministic scoring (not AI) drives the headline competitive-movement metric, ensuring reproducibility and explainability.

nodes.label: External Company View (Bonus)
nodes.rationale: Reuses the same crawl/signal pipeline on the company's own public website (company type own_company) to synthesize how the company is perceived externally, as a reality-check against the internal strategy context profile.

nodes.label: call_llm() single chokepoint architecture
nodes.rationale: Token usage is captured at the single LLM call chokepoint (call_llm() in backend/app/analyser/client.py) instead of at each of the 16 call sites, so no existing call site needs to change — usage recording is transparent to callers.

nodes.label: DB-backed runtime settings override mechanism
nodes.rationale: Settings stored in app_settings key/value table and applied via setattr onto the existing settings singleton at startup and on every admin edit. Rationale: backend runs single uvicorn worker (no --workers flag), so no multi-process cache invalidation needed; DB-backed overrides survive redeploys since Postgres persists independently of the container, unlike .env/GitHub variables which reset on each deploy.

nodes.label: Live cost calculation from editable price table
nodes.rationale: Costs are not frozen at call time but computed live from the current llm_model_price table (tokens / 1_000_000 * price) at display time, so historical cost figures reflect price corrections retroactively rather than being locked to pricing at time of call.
nodes.norm_label: live cost calculation from editable price table
